title: Four Siang dam protesters released in Arunachal after nearly month in detention

ai.summary: Four protesters detained over the Siang dam project were released after nearly a month, following the Siang Indigenous Farmers' Forum's demands for their freedom and other concessions.

facts.claim: Four protesters detained over the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh were released from Jully Central Jail near Itanagar on Saturday, nearly a month after their arrest
facts.quote: Itanagar, Four protesters detained over the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh were released from Jully Central Jail near Itanagar on Saturday, nearly a month after their arrest, officials said.

facts.claim: The four, identified as Adum Tayom, Omak Paron, Okut Paloh and Oson Paron, were detained on October 9 under the Arunachal Pradesh Unlawful Activities Act, 2014
facts.quote: The four, identified as Adum Tayom, Omak Paron, Okut Paloh and Oson Paron, were detained on October 9 under the Arunachal Pradesh Unlawful Activities Act, 2014, they added.

facts.claim: Their release came a day after the state government agreed to free them as a goodwill gesture while responding to demands raised by the Siang Indigenous Farmers' Forum
facts.quote: Their release came a day after the state government agreed to free them as a goodwill gesture while responding to demands raised by the Siang Indigenous Farmers' Forum , which has been leading the protest against the proposed mega dam.

facts.claim: The development marks a significant step towards easing tensions in the Siang Valley, where opposition to the project has triggered protests and confrontations in recent months
facts.quote: The development marks a significant step towards easing tensions in the Siang Valley, where opposition to the project has triggered protests and confrontations in recent months.

facts.claim: The government, however, maintained that the withdrawal of FIRs against protesters would have to follow due legal process
facts.quote: The government, however, maintained that the withdrawal of FIRs against protesters would have to follow due legal process.

facts.claim: The government has urged SIFF to resume dialogue and communicate a convenient date, along with a list of delegates, for a proposed meeting with Chief Minister Pema Khandu
facts.quote: The government has urged SIFF to resume dialogue and communicate a convenient date, along with a list of delegates, for a proposed meeting with Chief Minister Pema Khandu.

facts.claim: The release of the four protesters was among SIFF's key demands before agreeing to participate in talks with the government
facts.quote: The release of the four protesters was among SIFF's key demands before agreeing to participate in talks with the government.

facts.claim: The forum had earlier rejected Khandu's invitation for dialogue, insisting that its demands, including the release of detainees and withdrawal of security forces, be addressed first
facts.quote: The forum had earlier rejected Khandu's invitation for dialogue, insisting that its demands, including the release of detainees and withdrawal of security forces, be addressed first.

ai.background_note: The Siang Indigenous Farmers' Forum has been leading protests against the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project, which faces opposition from the Adi community over displacement and environmental concerns.
